classification.difficultyReason: Choose common positive powers to turn unlike roots into comparable integers, recognise that this preserves their order, and combine pairwise comparisons into one ranking.

content.prompt: Without using a calculator, list the numbers $2^{1/2}$, $3^{1/3}$ and $5^{1/5}$ in order from greatest to least.

answer.short:
$3^{1/3}>2^{1/2}>5^{1/5}$

Compare sixth powers for the first pair and tenth powers for the second pair.
answer.worked:
All three numbers are positive, so raising them to the same positive integer power preserves their order.
$$\begin{align*}(3^{1/3})^6&=9\\(2^{1/2})^6&=8\end{align*}$$
Since $9>8$, $3^{1/3}>2^{1/2}$.
$$\begin{align*}(2^{1/2})^{10}&=32\\(5^{1/5})^{10}&=25\end{align*}$$
Since $32>25$, $2^{1/2}>5^{1/5}$. Therefore,
$$3^{1/3}>2^{1/2}>5^{1/5}.$$
